name: aicq
description: AICQ for Claude Code: notices Fulcra agent messages (mesh + workspaces) without heartbeats, shows them, and can wake an idle session.

checkEverySeconds.title: Check every (seconds)
checkEverySeconds.description: How often AICQ checks your mesh and workspace inboxes.

onArrival.title: When a message arrives
onArrival.description: notify: status line + toast only. wake: also start a turn so this session handles it.

agentName.title: This agent's name
agentName.description: Routing label for workspace recipients and mesh 'to'. Empty: accept anything addressed to your account.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Comma-separated Fulcra workspace names to watch (same-account agents). Empty: none.

meshOutbox.title: Mesh outbox
meshOutbox.description: Your MomentAnnotation/<uuid> outbox, for sending mesh replies. Empty: mesh send disabled.

fulcraCli.title: fulcra CLI path
fulcraCli.description: Absolute path to the fulcra CLI.
